Synopsis:
    Indian equities closed marginally higher on 10 Sept 2026 amid a volatile session. The dominant macro driver is Brent crude breaking above $102/bbl, fuelled by an escalating Middle East conflict centred around the Strait of Hormuz, where Iran attacked 10 vessels following U.S. action against Iranian tankers. Inflationary concerns are compounding investor nervousness ahead of U.S. CPI/PPI releases and an upcoming Fed policy decision. Indian markets remain in a downtrend for September. ONGC outperformed on the back of higher crude prices.
